title: Whole-Brain Mapping in Adult Zebrafish and Identification of the Functional Brain Network Underlying the Novel Tank Test.
authors: Rajput, Neha; Parikh, Kush; Squires, Ada; Fields, Kailyn K; Wong, Matheu; Kanani, Dea; Kenney, Justin W
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习与光片显微镜绘制斑马鱼全脑活动图谱，研究行为相关脑网络，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Zebrafish have gained prominence as a model organism in neuroscience over the past several decades, generating key insight into the development and functioning of the vertebrate brain. However, techniques for whole-brain mapping in adult stage zebrafish are lacking. Here, we describe a pipeline built using open-source tools for whole-brain activity mapping in adult zebrafish. Our pipeline combines advances in histology, microscopy, and machine learning to capture c-fos activity across the entirety of the brain. Following tissue clearing, whole-brain images are captured using light-sheet microscopy and registered to the recently created adult zebrafish brain atlas (AZBA) for automated segmentation. By way of example, we used our pipeline to measure brain activity after zebrafish were subject to the novel tank test, one of the most widely used behaviors in adult zebrafish. c-fos levels peaked 15 min following behavior and several regions, including those containing serotoninergic and dopaminergic neurons, were active during exploration. Finally, we generated a novel tank test functional brain network. This revealed that several regions of the subpallium form a cohesive subnetwork during exploration. Functional interconnections between the subpallium and other regions appear to be mediated primarily by ventral nucleus of the ventral telencephalon (Vv), the olfactory bulb, and the anterior part of the parvocellular preoptic nucleus (PPa). Taken together, our pipeline enables whole-brain activity mapping in adult zebrafish while providing insight into neural basis for the novel tank test.
abstract_zh: 斑马鱼在过去几十年中作为神经科学中的模式生物而崭露头角，为脊椎动物大脑的发育和功能提供了关键见解。然而，针对成年斑马鱼的全脑映射技术仍然缺乏。在此，我们描述了一个利用开源工具构建的流程，用于成年斑马鱼的全脑活动映射。我们的流程结合了组织学、显微镜和机器学习方面的进展，以捕获整个大脑中的c-fos活动。在组织透明化处理后，使用光片显微镜 (light-sheet microscopy) 捕获全脑图像，并将其配准到最近创建的成年斑马鱼脑图谱 (adult zebrafish brain atlas, AZBA) 以进行自动分割。作为示例，我们使用该流程测量了斑马鱼在经历新水箱测试（成年斑马鱼中最常用的行为之一）后的大脑活动。c-fos水平在行为后15分钟达到峰值，包括含有血清素能和多巴胺能神经元的几个区域在探索期间处于活跃状态。最后，我们生成了新水箱测试的功能性脑网络。这揭示了在探索期间，亚脑室 (subpallium) 的几个区域形成了一个紧密的子网络。亚脑室与其他区域之间的功能性连接似乎主要由腹侧端脑腹侧核 (ventral nucleus of the ventral telencephalon, Vv)、嗅球 (olfactory bulb) 以及小细胞视前核前部 (anterior part of the parvocellular preoptic nucleus, PPa) 介导。综合来看，我们的流程实现了成年斑马鱼的全脑活动映射，同时为新水箱测试的神经基础提供了见解。
